description: This file defines a React context for managing music player state, including playback queue, current track, and controls such as play, pause, skip, volume, shuffle, and repeat. It contains a reducer function and a provider component for context management.

methods.name: playerReducer
methods.description: Reducer function handling playback state actions such as setting queue, play, pause, skip, and volume adjustments.

methods.name: PlayerProvider
methods.description: React component providing the PlayerContext to its children with state and dispatch via useReducer.
